query:
SELECT 
  f.id,
  f.client_id,
  c.name as client_name,
  f.page_id,
  f.page_name,
  f.is_active,
  f.auto_vapi_call,
  f.auto_sms,
  f.vapi_assistant_id,
  f.lead_tag,
  CASE WHEN f.page_access_token IS NOT NULL AND f.page_access_token != '' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END as has_token,
  f.created_at
FROM facebook_page_configs f
LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = f.client_id;
